name: Perphenazine
aliases: Decentan®, Fentazin®, Trilafon®, Αιθαπεραζίνη, Εταπεραζίνη, Περφαιναζίνη, Περφεναζίνα, Περφεναζίνη
summary: Perphenazine is a typical antipsychotic drug. Chemically, it is classified as a piperazinyl phenothiazine. Originally marketed in the United States as Trilafon, it has been in clinical use for decades.
